content: Apple VideoToolbox can require hardware decode at VTDecompressionSession creation, causing creation to fail when the exact requested format or configuration cannot be hardware decoded, and can report the selected path through kVTDecompressionPropertyKey_UsingHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder. Apple first advertised AV1 decode in the M3 media engine, but hardware family advertising is not a substitute for an exact stream probe. HEVC 4:4:4 should likewise be treated as unknown until the target bitstream creates and runs a measured decoder session. Sources: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/videotoolbox/kvtvideodecoderspecification_requirehardwareacceleratedvideodecoder, https://developer.apple.com/documentation/videotoolbox/kvtdecompressionpropertykey_usinghardwareacceleratedvideodecoder, and https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2023/10/apple-unveils-m3-m3-pro-and-m3-max-the-most-advanced-chips-for-a-personal-computer/.
